## 🏷️ Type of report

<!-- Tick one by changing [ ] to [x]. -->

- [ ] 🐞 **Bug:** broken link, diagram not rendering, search or navigation not working
- [ ] ✏️ **Content error:** something in the notes is wrong or misleading
- [ ] 🕰️ **Outdated content:** Azure or the exam has changed since this was written
- [ ] 📱 **Device issue:** the site looks or behaves wrongly on a specific device or browser
- [ ] 💬 **Other**
